items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Well I guess I only had the opportunity to play one job with him and that was an advertisement. On the truck.

ctx.x: Well I guess I only had the opportunity to play one job with him and that was an advertisement. On the truck. On the truck. Yes.
How was that kind of work, working on the truck Alba? Would that be harder than playing a dance or what would you say that kind of work would be?
No it wasn't harder than playing a dance because on the truck you'd just run, you'd just play about every second corner you'd play a short number. Just to draw the people's attention.
